channel.title: Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Radio Free Europe / Radio Liberty (rferl.org)

item.title: Israel Strikes Lebanon As Lawmaker Says Goal Is To 'Topple Regime' In Iran
item.description: Israel hit targets in Iran and southern Lebanon on the sixth day of the joint US-Israeli campaign. Reporting from Tel Aviv, RFE/RL correspondent Ray Furlong spoke to an opposition politician who said Israel's goal for a "final result" of the war is to bring down the regime in Tehran.

item.title: Trump Calls On Iran Forces To Lay Down Arms, Civilians To Revolt
item.description: US President Donald Trump called on members of Iran’s military, police, and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to lay down their arms, promising “total immunity” if they abandon the country’s ruling clerical establishment.

item.title: Dana Stroul: US, Israel Achieving Military Gains In Iran, But Political End Remains Unclear
item.description: US and Israeli air strikes are delivering military blows against Iran, but Washington still lacks a defined political strategy for what comes after the fighting, Dana Stroul, former deputy assistant secretary of defense for the Middle East said in an interview with Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.

item.title: Tears Of Joy And Sorrow: Mixed Emotions In Tehran As Toll Of War Mounts
item.description: With Iran coming under daily attack from US and Israeli air strikes, the toll of the expanding war is adding up both physically and mentally for the country's 92 million people.

item.title: Tehran Hit By Most Intense Strikes Of War
item.description: Iran's capital city saw the heaviest strikes witnessed so far on the seventh day of joint US-Israeli air attacks, according to social videos shared online. Verified user-generated video showed central areas of Tehran and government buildings coming under intense attacks.

item.title: Iran War Enters Its Second Week
item.description: Iran's leadership has been hit hard with Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and other senior officials killed in US and Israeli air strikes that continue to pound Tehran and other parts of the country. RFE/RL has continuing updates and analysis.

item.title: Tehran Resident Describes Mix Of Fear And Hope Amid Conflict
item.description: A woman living in Tehran describes witnessing heavy air attacks on the city, living in fear mixed with hope. The killing of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has brought "happiness about the dictator being gone" but that feeling is balanced with anxiety about the future, she told RFE/RL.

item.title: Israeli Air Defense Dominance Shapes War Strategy
item.description: A lone ruin in the center of Tel Aviv bears witness to the power of Iranian ballistic missiles. But the lack of other such sites underlines Israel's ability to shoot them down. RFE/RL's Ray Furlong reports from the Israeli capital.

item.title: White House Says US Looking At Potential Candidates To Lead Iran
item.description: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt says the United States is looking at potential candidates to lead Iran after President Donald Trump pushed Tehran to cease its resistance.

item.title: US Officials Confirm Russia Providing Targeting Intelligence To Iran In Middle East War
item.description: US officials on March 6 told RFE/RL that Russia is providing Iran with targeting information to attack US troops and military assets in the Middle East, confirming a Washington Post report that suggested Moscow is playing a substantial if indirect part in the widening regional conflict.
